notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024. IBM's Form 10-K (accession 0000051143-25-000015) incorporates its financial statements from the 2024 Annual Report filed as Exhibit 13 in the same submission; the figures were read from that exhibit and checked against SEC XBRL. OWNERSHIP: Ginni Rometty retired from IBM on December 31, 2020 and is not a director or named executive; she appears in the 2025 proxy (DEF 14A filed March 10, 2025, accession 0001104659-25-022186) only as the former principal executive officer in the pay-versus-performance table, not in either ownership table. Status no-reported-stake, values null. HOLDERS: the 5% table is 'as of December 31, 2024, except to the extent indicated otherwise in the footnotes'; each row is based on a Schedule 13G whose filing date the proxy gives (Vanguard February 7, 2025; BlackRock January 25, 2024; State Street January 30, 2024), so asOf is null and the BlackRock and State Street figures are probably stale. BUYBACKS: 0. IBM's program has been suspended since 2019; the cash-flow statement's only repurchase line is 'Common stock repurchases for tax withholdings' of $651 million, which is shares withheld to cover employees' taxes on vesting awards, not a buyback, so it is not counted. STOCK COMP: the note total equals the cash-flow add-back ($1,311 million). GEOGRAPHY: IBM also reports United States $25,144 million and other countries $37,609 million (Note D); the three-region table is used.

footprint.notes: IBM publishes no employee, facility or tax figures by state, country or region in its FY2024 10-K or annual report. Item 2 gives only floor space: about 41 million square feet worldwide, about 17 million in the U.S. (9 million owned, 8 million leased) and about 24 million outside the U.S. Floor space is not recorded because the lens has no square-feet unit. The 10-K says IBM operates in more than 175 countries and had 270,300 employees at wholly owned subsidiaries. The annual report also mentions the first IBM Quantum Data Center in Europe without naming a location, so it is not listed as a site.
